privacy.ai_training_note: Third-party AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, ElevenLabs) are contractually 'Forbidden from training AI on Fathom Customer Data' per the trust center subprocessor list. However, Fathom itself may by default use de-identified meeting content to train its own in-house AI models: 'Based on how you configure your account settings, we may use and create de-identified data generated from Meeting Content Information to improve our Services by training, improving, and customizing our in-house artificial intelligence models. You can opt out from this use of your data in your account settings.' Opt-out is account-level, not automatic. This is an opt-out (not opt-in) default, which is a flag for enterprise buyers.
privacy.data_region: United States only (Google Cloud Platform, USA). EU/UK transfers handled via Standard Contractual Clauses and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. No EU or UK data residency option. Privacy policy states: 'Services are hosted in the United States and intended for visitors located within the United States.'

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Yes - DPA states 'All data is encrypted in transit'

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Yes - DPA states data is encrypted 'at rest'; BAA requires 'maintain and transmit all PHI in encrypted manner'

security.name: Encryption key management
security.value: Trust center control: 'Encryption key access restricted'

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual; Penetration Test Report and Vulnerability Scan Report available on request via trust center

security.name: Security incident notification
security.value: 72 hours after becoming aware of a security incident (DPA); HIPAA BAA requires notification 'without unreasonable delay and no later than five (5) days following discovery'

security.name: Subprocessor controls
security.value: All AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, ElevenLabs) contractually forbidden from training on Fathom customer data; 10 business day advance notice for subprocessor changes; 30-day objection window for customers

security.name: SSO / SCIM
security.value: SSO available on Team tier and above; SCIM provisioning on Enterprise tier only

security.name: Cyber insurance
security.value: Maintained; 'Proof of Insurance - Commercial Liability' available in trust center

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Trust center lists: 'Unique account authentication enforced', 'Production application access restricted', 'Anti-malware technology utilized'

security.name: Data deletion on account termination
security.value: All recording and personal data removed on account deletion; backups cleared within 7 additional days per help center; DPA requires return or deletion at customer instruction

products.name: Fathom Free
products.data_scope: Unlimited recordings, transcripts, AI summaries. Calendar, meeting content (audio, video, transcript), user data.
products.notes: Permanently free for individuals. No SSO or SCIM. AI de-identified training opt-out applies here too. HIPAA BAA not available on this tier.

products.name: Fathom Premium
products.data_scope: Same as Free, plus advanced AI summary templates and conversational meeting assistant.
products.notes: $20/month or $16/month annually. No SSO. No HIPAA BAA.

products.name: Fathom Team
products.data_scope: Shared team recordings, global search across calls, team folders, keyword alerts. Calendar and meeting content data shared within workspace.
products.notes: $19/user/month (min 2 users). Basic SSO included. No HIPAA BAA at this tier.

products.name: Fathom Business
products.data_scope: Team data plus CRM field sync (Salesforce, HubSpot), AI scorecards, coaching metrics.
products.notes: $34/user/month (min 2 users). SSO included. No explicit HIPAA BAA noted at this tier.

products.name: Fathom Enterprise
products.data_scope: All Business features plus organization-wide security controls, custom data retention, SCIM provisioning.
products.notes: Custom pricing. HIPAA BAA available. SCIM provisioning. Custom data retention policies. Organization-wide security controls. Dedicated success manager.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: free forever for individuals; team/enterprise plans from $15-34/user/month; enterprise custom pricing
compare.data_residency: United States only; no EU or UK hosting option; SCCs and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework used for cross-border transfers

flags: AI training opt-out required: Fathom trains its in-house AI models on de-identified meeting content by default; users must manually opt out in account settings. This is not an opt-in consent model.

No ISO 27001 certification confirmed on vendor's own domain. Third-party aggregator (nudgesecurity.com) lists ISO 27001 but this is unverified and conflicts with the vendor's own trust center which does not list it. Do not list as ISO 27001 certified.
HIPAA BAA is only explicitly available on the Enterprise plan (custom pricing); lower tiers are not covered. Buyers needing HIPAA coverage must negotiate Enterprise.
All data is hosted in the United States (GCP); no EU or UK data residency option exists. EU/UK customers rely on SCCs and Data Privacy Framework for transfer compliance.
FedRAMP not listed on vendor's own domain; third-party aggregator claims unverified.
CSA STAR not listed on vendor's own domain; third-party aggregator claims unverified.
SSO available from Team tier; SCIM only on Enterprise. Free and Premium plans lack enterprise identity controls.
Fathom HQ (fathomhq.com) is a separate company with ISO 27001 - do not conflate with Fathom Video Inc. (fathom.ai).
